# Cirth v0.8.2

Cirth v0.8.2 is a maintenance release: it catches the published npm
metadata up to the Apache-2.0 relicense (closing gh#77 for good — `npm
view` was still reporting MIT since no release had shipped since the
license switch), fixes a WCAG AA contrast regression from 0.8.1, respects
an explicit `size` attribute on text inputs, and ships a batch of docs-site
fixes (the docs site itself moved from Astro to Eleventy, unrelated to the
published package). No breaking changes.

## Fixed

- **Published package now reports the correct license.** `package.json`
  has said `Apache-2.0` since the relicense, but no release had shipped
  since then, so `npm view @cirthcss/cirth license` was still showing
  `MIT`. This release picks it up (gh#77).
- **Invalid-form submit hint no longer breaks WCAG AA contrast.** The
  visual "not ready yet" state on submit buttons of `:invalid` forms
  (introduced in 0.8.1) now uses luminance-preserving `filter:
  grayscale(1)` instead of `opacity`, which pushed the button below the
  4.5:1 contrast floor.
- **`input[size]` no longer forced to full width** (gh#60) — the
  "Blocks, 100%" rule overrode an explicit `size` attribute, the
  standard way to size a field to its expected content (a postcode, a
  short code, an OTP digit group). `size` now opts a text input out of
  the full-width default.
- Docs site fixes: homepage hero rendering off-center on some
  viewports/browsers, and the docs header/footer/content columns not
  sharing the same width. Both were docs-shell bugs, not library bugs.

## Changed

- **Docs site migrated from Astro to Eleventy** — same content, same
  routes, same dogfooded-CSS shell. A far smaller dependency tree and
  slower release cadence for something that needs no client-side
  framework. Also restores heading-anchor permalinks and fixes the
  code-block copy button, both lost/broken in the earlier VitePress→Astro
  migration. This doesn't touch the published `@cirthcss/cirth` package.
- Docs code-block copy button restyled ghost (no border, always visible)
  instead of bordered and hover-revealed.

See the [Changelog](https://github.com/cirthcss/cirth/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#082---2026-08-11)
for the complete, itemized list.
